description: Lists bookmarks with optional keyword, exact URL, or folder filters.

fleetId.description: Fleet ID whose bookmark store should be queried.

query.description: Optional keyword matched against bookmark title or URL.

url.description: Optional exact URL lookup; an empty result means the URL is not bookmarked.

folderId.description: Optional folder ID to scope the listing.

purpose.description: Describe why you are listing bookmarks, e.g., finding a saved page
